Job Description:

Global Cards & Loyalty Solutions delivers shared technology capabilities for Private Bank and Corporate Bank. The domain covers global credit and debit card services, loyalty platforms and partner ecosystems, and is accountable for platform delivery, production stability and technical vendor integration.

The role is part of our overarching front-to-back testing framework within the F2B Test management / UAT sub-domain.


We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Test Automation Engineer at Vice President corporate title to provide technical leadership for quality engineering and test automation. The successful candidate will shape automation strategy, design scalable solutions for UI and API testing, and embed effective quality controls across the software delivery lifecycle. This is a hands-on senior role combining deep engineering expertise with stakeholder influence, mentoring, governance, and ownership of quality outcomes for highly visible, customer-relevant applications.


Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the test automation strategy, architecture, standards, and roadmap for web applications, APIs, and integrated services.
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks and reusable libraries using appropriate programming languages and tools.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex automation, testability, environment, data, and integration challenges.
  • Define risk-based test approaches and ensure the right balance of automated and manual testing across functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Partner with engineering leads, product owners, architects, DevOps teams, and control functions to embed quality from requirements through production.
  • Establish CI/CD quality gates and reliable execution of automated tests using platforms such as GitHub Actions or TeamCity.
  • Analyse test results and quality trends, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure defects and systemic quality risks are addressed.
  • Set measurable quality objectives and provide transparent reporting on automation coverage, execution stability, defect leakage, and release readiness.
  • Lead reviews of test design, code, framework changes, and automation pull requests, promoting maintainable engineering practices.
  • Mentor QA and engineering colleagues, build automation capability, and encourage knowledge sharing and consistent adoption of standards.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and technologies, lead proofs of concept, and make evidence-based recommendations for investment and adoption.
  • Contribute to Agile ceremonies, delivery planning, release decisions, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Remain calm and solution-oriented during critical delivery phases, applying strong technical judgement to protect customer experience and organisational reputation.

Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation, including substantial hands-on UI and API automation experience.
  • Proven experience leading automation design, technical standards, or quality engineering initiatives across multiple teams or a complex product area.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python, with sound knowledge of clean code, design patterns, version control, and code review practices.
  • Advanced experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
  • Strong API testing experience using tools or libraries such as Postman, Newman, REST Assured, or equivalent.
  • Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, defect management, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience designing scalable, maintainable automation frameworks, including locator strategy, test data management, reporting, parallel execution, and environment configuration.
  • Ability to interpret quality metrics and communicate release risks, options, and recommendations clearly to technical and senior business stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and lead through ambiguity in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Strong knowledge of common web application technologies, distributed systems, and integration patterns.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Well-being & Benefits 

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.  

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness. 
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace. 
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.  
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts. 
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health. 

Physically thriving: We support you in managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-ups. 

Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.  

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays). 
  • Hybrid working model with 40% remote work. 
  • Options for flexible working hours. 
  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more. 

Financially secure: We support you in meeting personal financial goals during your active career and for the future. 

  • Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose. 
  • Meal vouchers, bonuses for referrals 

  

Interested in more: discover what our employees value in the Well-being & Benefits hub! 

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
